content.text: to draw my flesh with wine
the number of the days of their life
, and that of all sorts: Heb. musical instrument, and instruments
in those things which have been already done
that there is an excellency in Wisdom more then in folly
happeneth to me, even to me

content.heading: The Vanity of Work and Riches

content.text: and wherein I have shewed myself wise
that they might clear God, and see
this is the envy of a man from his neighbour
who knoweth not to be admonished
there is a good which is comely
the number of the days of the life of his vanity
as good as an inheritance, yea, better too
those that are given to it.
when he that is a fool
upon the face of the waters
of her that is with child:
the more wise the preacher was
the end of the matter, even all that hath been heard, is
